design.note: Not a variant property in Figma. Circular and Bar are modelled as separate component sets. The Figma component overview calls this property Type; the canonical name follows the code prop variant, as it does for Button.
Not a variant property in Figma. Indeterminate and Determinate are modelled as separate component sets per variant. The component overview lists Indeterminate as the canonical property.

design.name: 🔀 State
design.note: The value set differs per component set: indeterminate offers Active (default), Successful and Critical; determinate offers Inactive (default), Active, Successful and Critical. Same Figma property name in all four sets, therefore one entry with the union of values and no single default.

design.name: ✏️ Label
design.note: In code the label text can also be passed as children. The label prop takes precedence, children act as the fallback.

properties.name: showLabel
properties.description: Enables/disables the visibility of the label

design.name: ✏️ Progress
design.note: Determinate only. The indeterminate component sets carry no progress text. The Figma property is named Progress, the code prop progressText.

properties.name: showProgressText
properties.description: Enables/disables the visibility of the progressText

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Change the orientation. Defaults to horizontal.

design.name: 🔀 Orientation
design.note: Circular only. The bar component sets carry no orientation. The defaults differ: Figma defaults to Vertical, the code prop defaults to horizontal.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size attribute changes the font-size and other related sizes of the component.

design.name: 🔀 Size
design.note: The value sets differ: Figma additionally offers Large, the shared SizeList in code only covers small and medium. The canonical values follow the code.

properties.name: autoDisable
properties.description: Disable the parent component (e.g. a DBButton) when loading indicator is inside it

properties.name: delay
properties.description: Add a delay before showing the component

properties.name: onTimeout
properties.description: Triggers after a timeout. For "active" after 5 seconds, for "successful" and "critical" after 2 seconds
